addOperation.name: prettyISBN

Note.NoteContent: Multiple copies for the same book edition: If all attributes were specified in a single class BOOK, many values need to specified redundantly (e.g., title). The operation "getBookTitle" in BOOKCOPY shows that we can access attributes of the linked book object without needing to redefine them.

Attribute "isbn: Abstract_ISBN" uses a domain-specific type and serves as a further example for LU5: Types for Attributes. The classes ABSTRACT_ISBN, ISBN_10, and ISBN_13 are specified in a separate diagram that can be accessed from the Control Center. The objects "isbn_131" and "isbn_132" that are used in the BOOKEDITION objects are hidden in this diagram. You can show them in View->Hide/Unhide Elements.
